entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment:
•For tariff heading 0101 excluded race horses.
•For tariff heading 0106, reduced rate applies only on rabbits, pigeons, quail, pheasants, partridges, hares and other animals and birds, live, intended for human consumption. Animals set are reared for fur. Bees. Mites (insects used in crops instead of pesticides).
•For tariff heading 0301, excluded live fish for decoration

entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment: As from 01/01/2021 sugar-sweetened beverages are subject to the standard VAT rate (21%)

entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment:
Goods listed in Annex 3 to the Polish VAT Act.
Feedingstuffs for livestock and petfood (regardless of CN code): As regards CN codes: 0106 (only rabbits, ostriches, bees, silkworms, bumblebees, arthropods, trained dogs for the blind), 2101 (only roasted chicory and other roasted coffee substitutes, and extracts, essences and concentrates)
